_comment: Profile links for individuals, keyed by org slug: website (personal or faculty page), twitter, linkedin, manifund, lesswrong, eaforum. `bun run seed` writes them to orgs.links and clears the links of any org not listed, so this file owns that column. `bun run find-person-links` fills manifund (and whatever the Manifund profile links to) for people with grants on Manifund, without overwriting anything already here; the rest is hand research. Only list a profile confirmed to be this person; delete a key to take a link off the site, or set it to null to keep find-person-links from proposing it again.
